title: Dengue deaths reach 483 as admissions drop to 1,255
excerpt: Two people died in Dhaka division in the 24 hours to 8am on 13 November, and new admissions fell well below the 2,000 a day seen earlier in the week.

image.alt: The medicine ward building of Rajshahi Medical College Hospital
image.credit: Nahid Hossain / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

content:
Two people died of dengue and 1,255 were admitted to hospital in the 24 hours to 8am on Friday, 13 November, according to Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) data reported by The Business Standard and bdnews24.com. Both deaths were in hospitals in Dhaka division.

The numbers

  • Deaths this year: 483.
  • Hospital cases this year: 158,883.
  • New admissions: 434 in Dhaka division and 821 outside it, led by Chattogram (267), Khulna (160) and Barishal (147).
  • In hospital now: 5,915, according to The Business Standard.
  • Trend: daily admissions over the last five bulletins were 2,260, 1,595, 1,900, 1,960 and 1,255.

Why it matters

One lower day does not make a trend. But two thirds of new patients are now outside Dhaka division, with the coastal divisions of Chattogram, Khulna and Barishal carrying much of the load. NGOs running health and WASH work in those districts can push larval source clean-ups and early referral for fever, especially where children may also have measles.

What to watch

Whether admissions stay below 1,500 a day into next week as temperatures fall.
